dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) v02 VIEW — Listed Building polygons (layer 3)
evidence_slice: Historic England's current NHLE record for ListEntry 1239561, Nos. 161 and 163 Magdalen Road, Exeter, identifies the asset as a pair of early-C19 detached villas, Grade II, with a most recent amendment dated 19 July 2016. Historic England's current Open Data Hub/API layer 3 is 'Listed Building polygons', an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer whose fields bind ListEntry, Name, Grade, ListDate, AmendDate, CaptureScale, hyperlink, area_ha, NGR, Easting and Northing in the same feature. Historic England's Open Data Hub terms state that all new Listed buildings and substantive amendments since 4 April 2011 will contain a mapped polygon around the principal listed building. The exact no-login layer-3 query for ListEntry 1239561 was attempted with returnGeometry=true and outSR=4326, but the response payload was inaccessible through the available retrieval channel; therefore no polygon coordinates were read or fabricated.

field_evidence.footprint: Layer 3 is an official esriGeometryPolygon layer binding ListEntry/Name/Grade/AmendDate to geometry, but the exact ListEntry 1239561 query payload was not retrievable, so no polygon coordinates are available.
